content: Select one exact immutable Vermory artifact and record its public HTTPS URI, filename, byte size, SHA-256, and exact source revision without credentials or callback parameters.
Declare the protocol, unique submission ID, random nonce, UTC validity interval, suite profile, public interfaces, runtime platforms, and evaluator-controlled execution boundary.
Strictly parse the submission, reject unknown fields and unsafe URIs, and compute one canonical digest independent of JSON formatting.
Modify the local implementation artifact and require filename, size, or SHA-256 verification to reject it before execution.
Run the artifact with an ephemeral PostgreSQL database, evaluator-owned provider proxy, no other outbound network, disabled telemetry, and evaluator-controlled detailed artifacts.
Keep private case text, expected answers, randomized identities, provider credentials, prompts, outputs, and detailed scoring outside implementation access.

Return only a version-2 Ed25519-signed attestation with exact submission and implementation digests, suite and run identity, aggregate counts, hard-gate statuses, failure categories, and detailed-result digest.
Verify the attestation with the exact out-of-band evaluator public key and exact public submission.
Substitute another submission, implementation digest, suite profile, protocol, evaluator key, or out-of-window run time and require rejection.
Report inconsistent case counts or claim hard-gate success while a gate failed or did not run and require rejection.
Confirm the production CLI creates and verifies submissions and verifies external attestations but exposes no attestation signing command.
Record protocol qualification separately from an externally recorded run and retain the genuine external evaluator as an open boundary until a valid outside attestation exists.
